Archival Dispatch: 17 Master Broadcasts Dated Across The Golden Days of Radio, 1960s Psychedelic Spots, and Ripley's One-Minute Curiosities

Date: 2026-08-21
Author: radio index
Reading: 4 min

Raw Markdown

Batch 22 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 22 resolves 17 historic radio productions: 8 weekly broadcast retrospectives hosted by radio historian Frank Bresee on The Golden Days of Radio (including master audio from Kraft Music Hall with Bing Crosby & Al Jolson, John Barrymore with W.C. Fields, and Johnny Carson), 4 rare 1960s promotional and advertising master tapes (including Sean Connery's original Thunderball radio campaign and Frank Zappa's Secret Ceremony cinema spot), and 5 syndicated 1948 master discs of Ripley's Believe It or Not - One Minute Episodes.

1. The Golden Days of Radio — 1968 Master Syndication Discs Dated

Produced and narrated by Frank Bresee, spotlighting golden age audio treasures:
